title: Reduce Helius throttling and scanner pressure
target: wallet balance RPC, Helius retries, active scan universe
current: Wallet USDC queried repeatedly; direct Helius holder RPC has no retry backoff; active watch can exceed 1,000 tokens while 150 are scanned per cycle.
proposed: Cache wallet USDC for 300s with stale fallback; retry Helius 429/5xx up to 3 times with exponential backoff; shorten persistent watch to 2h and cap active scanning at 100 tokens/cycle.

Live scanner reported 1,015 active watch tokens against a 150-token scanner cap.
wallet_usdc_balance() was called from several paths and performed a direct RPC request without caching.
risk: A cached wallet balance can be stale for up to five minutes; a smaller active scan cap can defer lower-priority retained tokens. Fresh discovery remains prioritized.
